_status: HELD-INACTIVE 2026-10-04: Noel 07188925 is the candidate primary, but has no verified recreational ladder. Full release also needs private launch placement and separate upper/lower routing at Shadow Lake Dam. See elk-release-review-2026-10-04.md. No activation authorized by this dossier.
name: Elk River
description: A warm, popular summer float in Missouri's far southwestern corner around Pineville and Noel. Clear, spring-influenced water over gravel bars and beneath bluffs, with heavy party-float traffic in season — but rain-driven and prone to fast, flashy rises.
managingAuthority: MDC at Mount Shira and Cowskin; City of Pineville at its cooperative access; private operators at their own facilities.

regulations.text: Camping is prohibited at Mount Shira and Cowskin accesses.
Private launch and landing passes are offered by Elk River Floats; arrange access with the operator.

accessLaw.value: Use the agency-listed public accesses or an operator landing under its published pass/rental arrangements. This dossier does not infer launch or camping permission from a road crossing, gravel bar, or historical guide.

gauges.name: Elk Rv at MO-59, Noel, MO
gauges.knownBias: At Noel, below Indian Creek and near Shadow Lake. It does not establish the upper Pineville reach condition without reach-specific observations; no discharge series is published in the inspected metadata.

sections.name: Elk River: Pineville–Noel and lower Elk to Cowskin
sections.description: Release research covers the Elk mainstem from Pineville to Noel and, separately, below Shadow Lake Dam to Cowskin. Upper and lower trips are not a verified continuous route. Indian Creek joins above Trestle Park; operator trips on the upper river can be seasonal. Eddy miles begin at the Big Sugar/Little Sugar confluence; historical combined-creek guide miles use a different origin.

putIn.name: City of Pineville Elk River Access

representativeGauge.rationale: Live USGS mainstem stage gauge at Noel. Candidate only until Noel-specific recreational observations or operator guidance establish the thresholds.
representativeGauge.knownBias: At Noel, below Indian Creek and near Shadow Lake. It does not establish the upper Pineville reach condition without reach-specific observations; no discharge series is published in the inspected metadata.

publishedFloatTimes.reachLabel: Trestle Park to Wayside (Noel River Float Trip)

characteristics.lowWaterMeaning: Shallow gravel bars can require dragging, especially above Indian Creek; no Noel-stage cutoff is signed off.
characteristics.risingWaterHazards: Rain-driven rises; Shadow Lake Dam separates upper and lower trips.

hazards.value: Shadow Lake Dam near Noel separates upper and lower trips. A mapped dam is not evidence of a usable legal portage.
A low-water crossing is at the Trestle Park area below Indian Creek. Precise structure placement remains to be verified before a structured point is added.

localKnowledge: Pineville and Noel are the main trip bases. Rentals, shuttles and camping are concentrated along the upper mainstem.
Published six- and twelve-mile operator routes are rounded product distances; they do not validate unplaced access pins.
Mount Shira and Cowskin prohibit camping. Book a private campground for an overnight stay.
Bluff Dwellers Cave is a drive-to attraction south of Noel, not an on-water cave stop.

accessPoints.name: City of Pineville Elk River Access
accessPoints.notes: City-maintained Elk River access under an MDC cooperative agreement. Reach the parking area from Rhine Road; use the developed launch, not the highway bridge.

accessPoints.name: US-71 Bridge (I-49) Access
accessPoints.notes: HELD: the previous coordinate identified the I-49/US-71 bridge, not a verified launch. Use the separate City of Pineville access. A public road crossing alone is not evidence of permission to launch.

accessPoints.name: Mount Shira Access
accessPoints.notes: MDC access on the west bank, reached from Highway 59 north of Noel. Existing bank pin retained; the MDC area map confirms the launch layout.

accessPoints.name: Noel / Shadow Lake Access (Hwy 59 bridge)
accessPoints.notes: HELD: the former pin was a bridge coordinate with no established ramp or landing rights. The historical Noel City Park access is on Butler Creek, not this bridge. Verify an operator landing at Wayside or River Ranch/Sycamore separately.

accessPoints.name: Sycamore Landing
accessPoints.notes: A distinct campground near River Ranch in Noel. Operator map shows river access and a float landing; launch/landing coordinates and independent-boat arrangements remain to be verified. Campground business coordinates must not be substituted for an endpoint.

accessPoints.name: Cowskin Access
accessPoints.notes: Public access on the lower Elk near Tiff City. A trip from above Noel crosses Shadow Lake Dam; no through-route portage has been verified.

accessPoints.name: Lanagan Access
accessPoints.notes: EXCLUDED from Elk endpoints: MDC identifies this as Indian Creek access. The former Elk snap was over 2.3 km away. Retain for a separate Indian Creek dossier.

Validate separate upper/lower route choices around Shadow Lake Dam; verify the low-water crossing pin and disposition.
Confirm reusable access and hero photography. Pineville agency image is restricted to MDC; bridge records used unrelated photographs.

Connected private-endpoint snaps, distances, shuttle roads and API results on web/iOS after applying the reviewed data.

corridor.notes: Pineville–Noel plus a separate lower Elk corridor to Cowskin. No Big Sugar/Indian Creek launch expansion or Grand Lake route in this release.

legalAccess.notes: Three agency-backed public accesses verified. Two stored bridge launches need withdrawal; private landing placement/terms are outstanding.

gauge.notes: Noel is live and stage-only (801 sq mi); production still links inactive Tiff City. Candidate linkage/curation awaits calibrated threshold signoff.

conditions.notes: No Noel-specific recreational thresholds found. Current outfitter level page still embeds 07189000. Neither datum subtraction nor an overlapping-cfs transfer is supported.

hazards.notes: Existing Shadow Lake Dam row confirmed; through-route portage is unverified and Trestle crossing still needs an exact point. Scope is these fixed features only.

routing.notes: All ten existing approved pairs return valid polylines and plausible lengths, but four cross the dam and some use unsupported bridge launches. Private endpoints and shuttle roads remain unverified.
